meta_description: Fine Gardening in Leeds offers expert landscape design, garden maintenance, and hard landscaping. Friendly, reliable local service. Call 07729 949361 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Experts — Design to Installation
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden redesigns, we create outdoor spaces that work for your home and lifestyle.
services_subhead: We handle everything from garden design and planting to patios, fencing, and year-round maintenance.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, lifestyle, and budget. We'll produce detailed plans and manage the whole project from conception to completion.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert planting schemes using shrubs, perennials, and seasonal colour. We source quality plants and create gardens that look great year-round with minimal fuss.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, decking, paths, and raised beds built to last. We use quality materials and precise finishing to create functional outdoor living areas.

services.title: Fencing & Screening
services.desc: New fence installation, repairs, and privacy screening. We supply and fit panels, posts, and gates that enhance your garden's boundaries and appearance.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance visits to keep your garden looking its best. Lawn care, hedge cutting, weeding, and seasonal tidying—weekly, fortnightly, or monthly.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Pruning, shaping, and removal of trees and large shrubs. We keep your planting healthy, safe, and properly proportioned to the garden.

about_pullquote: I started Fine Gardening because I believe every garden should be loved and cared for properly.
about_para_1: Fine Gardening has been creating and maintaining beautiful gardens across Leeds for over 12 years. Founded on the belief that good design and careful attention to detail transform outdoor spaces, we've built a reputation for listening to what customers want and delivering results that exceed expectations. Every garden we touch reflects our commitment to thoughtful planting, quality craftsmanship, and genuine care.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat their gardens like our own. We're not cowboys—we're neighbours who understand Leeds gardens, the local soil, and what grows well here. Whether you need a complete redesign, regular maintenance, or specialist work like tree surgery, you get the same friendly, professional approach and honest pricing.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Gardeners Say About Fine Gardening

reviews.text: Completely transformed our back garden. Had a terrible overgrown mess, and now it's the garden we've always wanted. The team were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Fine Gardening for maintenance for three years now. They're reliable, they show up when they say they will, and the garden looks immaculate. Worth every penny and honestly cheaper than other quotes we got.
reviews.author: Christine P.

reviews.text: Had them design and build a new patio and planting scheme. Brilliant from start to finish. They listened to what we wanted, gave honest advice, and the finished job is stunning. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David M.
